newsitem.title: USA: Apple to ship eMate, MessagePad this qtr.
newsitem.headline: Apple to ship eMate, MessagePad this qtr.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc Monday said it intends to ship the Apple eMate 300 and MessagePad 2000 Newton-based mobile computers this quarter as previously announced.
In a statement, the company said the products are expected to be in the market next month.

The MessagePad 2000 is a handheld mobile computer for the business professional and provides desktop connectivity to both Windows and Macintosh computers. Core applications ranging from e-mail and web access to personal productivity are all built in. The MessagePad 2000, which weighs 1.4 pounds, features the 160 MHz StrongARM processor which makes it one of the fastest handheld computers on the market.

The eMate 300 is a low-cost mobile computer which features multi-platform desktop and network connectivity for education. Designed with input from educators, it offers an affordable way to make technology accessible to more students than ever before. With a battery life of up to 28 continuous hours before recharging, the eMate 300 makes it possible for students to work for long periods of time wherever they want.
Both products feature Apple's Newton operating system.
